none: PAS SWYOR-D86C08: Roman coin; a nummus of Magnentius (350-353). Two Victories reverse
contea di ritrovamento: Wakefield (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin; a nummus of Magnentius (350-352AD). The reverse is in poor condition, but the end of the inscription reads ‘CA(E)S’, making it between 350 and 352AD. The mint mark is illegible, and therefore unknown. For reference see LRBC, 650-657
